# Site Machinery NZ

Site Machinery NZ is the New Zealand specialist supplier of DeSite soil, gravel and aggregate screening equipment — Nelson showroom, nationwide supply.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://sitemachinery.nz/): Soil, gravel and aggregate screeners NZ — on-site grading to cut buy-in, tip fees and haulage. Container pre-order: 10% off through 31 December 2026.
- [Portable screening equipment](https://sitemachinery.nz/products): DeSite Proscreens and Static Grizzlies matched to skid steers, loaders, excavators and tractors.
- [Contact / pricing](https://sitemachinery.nz/contact): Phone 027 521 2126, email info@sitemachinery.nz, showroom at 105 Pascoe Street, Nelson 7011.
- [About](https://sitemachinery.nz/about): Site Machinery NZ — exclusive DeSite screener supplier based in Nelson.
- [Screener mesh sizes](https://sitemachinery.nz/screening-recommendation): Mesh charts for topsoil, farm filling, cow races, compost, mulch and aggregate (imperial openings with metric anchors).
- [Farm gravel screener](https://sitemachinery.nz/for/farmers): Farm river gravel and cow race filling — 100 mm then 50 mm or 3 inch (~75 mm) screening.
- [Soil screener for civil contractors](https://sitemachinery.nz/for/civil-contractors): On-site soil and gravel screening for subdivisions, building works and retaining-wall fill.
- [Topsoil screener for landscapers](https://sitemachinery.nz/for/topsoil-landscaping): On-site topsoil, compost and yard soil grading for landscapers.
- [Gravel & aggregate screening equipment](https://sitemachinery.nz/for/aggregate-and-road-metal): Road metal, pea gravel, septic stone and drainage rock screening.
- [Nelson screening equipment showroom](https://sitemachinery.nz/for/nelson-nationwide): View machines at Pascoe Street, Nelson; supply across New Zealand including Tasman and the South Island.

## Lead Times, Shipping & Customization

- **Pre-Order Lead Time:** Safe bet is 2 months for next scheduled container shipment landing in New Zealand.
- **Freight / Shipping Calculation:** Dispatched from showroom at 105 Pascoe Street, Nelson. Freight is quoted directly based on client location anywhere in the North or South Island for transparent landed cost.
- **Riser Box Benefit:** Both vibrating feeders and Grizzlies come with riser box packages — elevating the screen deck to create larger pile clearance underneath so operators clear screened material less often.
- **Screen Swaps & Mesh Customization:** All DeSite screeners feature interchangeable mesh decks that can be swapped and re-tensioned in 10–15 minutes using ~10 nuts and a deep socket.
- **Standard Mesh Sizes:**
  - Static Grizzly: Standard 100mm square openings for heavy scalping and oversize rock removal.
  - Vibrating Feeders (SLG-78VF): Standard 20mm vertical × 100mm horizontal openings, producing ~18mm gravel.
- **Inclined Screen Aperture Physics:** Effective screen sizing is approximately 8% smaller than nominal flat aperture due to deck slope.
- **Dual-Unit Operation:** Operators frequently run two vibrating units in series (e.g. 100×100mm primary scalp, 20×100mm secondary finish) for multi-grade production.
